recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If exact parity of the moved CRMI ShareablePlanDefinition profile with the R5 core slices is still desired, reconcile that in the CRMI/source package rather than reintroducing the retired core profile.
issue_request: FHIR-32638 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested cqf-knowledgeCapability and cqf-knowledgeRepresentationLevel on ShareablePlanDefinition; the final resolution also required cqf-artifactComment, matching ShareableLibrary.
initial_application: Commit 2fef952c02f008cd94218eb3bcd286d6a6d4ce7b added PlanDefinition.extension:knowledgeCapability, PlanDefinition.extension:knowledgeRepresentationLevel, and PlanDefinition.extension:artifactComment slices to source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-profile-shareableplandefinition.xml, and the Jira links PR 2657.
additional_context: Later applied issue FHIR-48393 removed ShareablePlanDefinition and related shareable/publishable profiles from core for R6 because they had already moved to CRMI. Current core source keeps PlanDefinition and the Shareable logical pattern in build scope, but has no active ShareablePlanDefinition profile source or fhir.ini/profile reference beyond the historical OID entry; the Shareable pattern page directs implementers to CRMI.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and intentionally made no core source change. Restoring or editing the retired core profile would conflict with the later R6 removal decision.
